description: This Lua script tests the functionality of the utf8 library, including functions such as utf8.len, utf8.offset, utf8.codepoint, utf8.char, and utf8.codes. It verifies the correct handling of UTF-8 encoding, decoding, edge cases, error conditions, and supplementary characters.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: Helper function to assert that a function call produces an expected error message.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Returns the length of a UTF-8 string in characters by removing continuation bytes.

methods.name: checksyntax
methods.description: Constructs a string from codepoints and verifies it matches the original string.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive set of checks on a UTF-8 string and its codepoints, validating encoding, decoding, and error conditions.
